article.headline: West Florida opens season with a 127-42 win over Southeastern Baptist
article.description: — D.J. Shine’s 20 points helped West Florida open its season with a 127-42 victory over Southeastern Baptist on Monday.
article.linkText: West Florida opens season with a 127-42 win over Southeastern Baptist

categories.description: Southeastern Baptist Chargers @ West Florida Argonauts

event.description: Southeastern Baptist Chargers @ West Florida Argonauts

keywords: Southeastern Baptist Chargers @ West Florida Argonauts
article.story: PENSACOLA, Fla. -- — D.J. Shine’s 20 points helped West Florida open its season with a 127-42 victory over Southeastern Baptist on Monday. Shine had three steals for the Argonauts. Eze Wali added 18 points while shooting 8 for 10 from the field, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc, and had three steals. Christian Monroe shot 5 for 9 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, and 3 for 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points. Adin Johnson led the Chargers with 12 points and two steals. DJ Spencer added six points and three steals for Southeastern Baptist. AJ Jones also had six points. Up next West Florida visits Florida International on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
